narration.full_text: Let's quickly review some key concepts from trigonometry. We'll focus on the definitions of the six trigonometric ratios in a right-angled triangle. Remember, these ratios relate the angles of a triangle to the lengths of its sides. Understanding these fundamental relationships is crucial for solving trigonometric problems. Keep these definitions in mind as we continue our journey through mathematics.
